snippet.title: Mr. Records - Official Shine Level Gameplay Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Check out gameplay from the Shine Level of Mr. Records in this new trailer for the upcoming uplifting adventure where every vinyl transports you into a world of memories and emotion. Mr. Records will be available on PC and Xbox Series X/S in spring 2027.

Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
